# New generic row service: bounded optional Wolf follow-up

Your accepted copied representative scene remains preserved; no further human review or publication is inferred. Generic optional colour rows now pass both engines plus a no-option refusal control:25groups/5,437,440 decoded pixels, zero faults, exact legacy compatibility and scoped cleanup. It costs1184 optional image bytes/32 staticDRAM, no framebuffer image or task. FSIM is preparing its real copied/direct consumer. Priority6502/FSIM continues; no whole Wolf game prerequisite.

If you have direct Author work in progress, retain its priority and report a deferral. Otherwise please freeze a bounded separate optional adaptation of your existing representative renderer to final stores into borrowed hidden SBGR2222 rows. Start with source/host/build preparation only: same scene/DDA/oracle and math, caller-owned row table/scratch, no full-colour dummy frame, protected sync/group-padding/outside bits, no pointer past END/RUN, preserved copied control. Measure actual workspace/code/static call-chain differences; do not assume speed. No renderer-wide redesign or game migration. Owner task/TODO and immutable plan precede code. Return finite same-scene bit-exact/error/lifecycle plan and concrete package/stack pins before any target request.
